items.title: New research into multicancer blood tests
items.summary: A new trial is looking to see if a blood test at GP surgeries can spot those at risk of liver and other abdominal cancers. The new trial, called STRIDE, is looking at a possible way of spotting which people with abdominal symptoms are most likely to have cancer.

items.title: Liver UK joins call for safer health information in the age of AI
